data.explanation: Your building's owners' association will read the heating cost meters and service the smoke alarms in your flat. Three dates are offered: 12, 14 or 16 January 2026, each between 8:00 and 12:00. Tell the management company (Hausverwaltung) which date suits you, so someone can get into your flat. The reply period is counted in working days from the letter date; the app shows the deadline. The letter states no consequence, but if you don't reply, you may miss the chance to choose a date. Someone must be home.
